description: Migrate LLM API code from Google Gemini, OpenAI, or Anthropic Claude to Amazon Nova 2 Lite (boto3 Bedrock Runtime Converse API). Handles SDK swap, authentication, request/response reshaping, tool calling, structured output, multimodal, streaming, and reasoning config. Covers all major SDK patterns: google-genai, openai (Chat Completions, Responses, Assistants), anthropic Messages API, and OpenAI/Claude on Bedrock.
name: nova-api-migration
